description: This Java source file defines the 'AttractionListActivity' class, which is an Android activity responsible for displaying a list of tourist attractions sorted by distance. It manages permission requests for location access, initializes the UI, handles menu actions for testing notifications and toggling geofence settings, and interacts with utility services for location updates and geofencing.

classes.name: AttractionListActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for listing tourist attractions, handling location permissions, menu actions, and interactions with location and geofencing services.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, adds the attraction list fragment, and manages location permission checks.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Requests location updates via UtilityService when the activity resumes.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles action bar menu item clicks for testing notifications, microapps, and toggling geofence settings.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the location permission request, granting access if approved.

methods.name: requestFineLocationPermission
methods.description: Requests ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION permission from the user.

methods.name: fineLocationPermissionGranted
methods.description: Runs additional setup after confirming location permission is granted.

methods.name: showPermissionSnackbar
methods.description: Displays a Snackbar explaining why location permission is needed and prompts for permission.

methods.name: showDebugDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog with provided title and message for debugging purposes.
